title.narrative: Floods in La Mojana subregion Start Fund Alert 818

description.narrative: The project aims to provide a coordinated and timely response to immediate needs in the Food Security and WASH sectors:_x000d_ 1. Delivery of family hygiene kits._x000d_ 2. Promotion of key hygiene practices, with emphasis on strengthening the confidence, knowledge and skills of girls and women to manage their menstruation safely._x000d_ 3. Delivery of family WASH Kits._x000d_ 4. Recommendations to contribute to the prevention and/or reduction of the risk of transmission of dengue, chikungunya, zika and other urban arboviruses._x000d_ 5. Provision of food in-kind for the prevention of food insecurity._x000d_ 6. Sensitizing the community affected by the humanitarian emergency caused by floods on the prevention of GBV, providing accessible and relevant information to help identify, prevent and respond to situations of violence, especially in contexts of double affectation by armed conflict._x000d_ Beneficiaries: _x000d_ • 200 families receive hygiene kits._x000d_ • 200 families recognize safe hygiene practices._x000d_ • 550 families receive WASH kits._x000d_ • 550 families are provided with recommendations to contribute to the prevention and/or reduction of the risk of transmission of dengue, chikungunya, zika and other urban arboviruses._x000d_ • 160 families receive food in-kind for the prevention of food insecurity. _x000d_ • The community affected by the humanitarian emergency (mainly the 550 families) has accessible and relevant information to identify, prevent and respond to GBV situations.
